'''Mount Deldarca''' was an active [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on an unknown [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was the site of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base known as [[Dalgeer's Rim]]. The base of the volcano was riddled with tunnels that were formed by flowing [[Magma/Legends|lava]]. This made Mount Deldarca an ideal location to house a base, as most of the excavation work was already done for them. By tapping into the lava within the volcano, the Alliance had an unlimited supply of geothermal energy.<ref name="HS" />
